Mauricio Pochettino has heavily criticised VAR in Manchester United's loss at Liverpool after Leny Yoro's red card was overturned, while the Argentine believes Dominik Szoboszlai’s opener should not have stood. Yoro's one-match suspension for the red card he was shown in the 4-0 defeat at Anfield has been removed, despite referees' chief Howard Webb supporting the decision to send him off. Man Utd will contact ProRef and the Premier League directly over what they believe to be a 'totally wrong' interpretation of Yoro's red card against Liverpool.
